title: First Bancorp Announces Cash Dividend
summary: The Board of Directors of First Bancorp (NASDAQ: FBNC) (the "Company"), the parent company of First Bank, has declared a cash dividend on its common stock of $0.24 per share payable on October 23, 2026 to shareholders of record as of September 30, 2026.

title: 1 Russell 2000 Stock to Consider Right Now and 2 That Underwhelm
summary: Small-cap stocks in the Russell 2000 (^RUT) can be a goldmine for investors looking beyond the usual large-cap names. But with less stability and fewer resources than their bigger counterparts, these companies face steeper challenges in scaling their businesses.

title: Regional Banks Stocks Q2 In Review: First Bancorp (NASDAQ:FBNC) Vs Peers
summary: The end of the earnings season is always a good time to take a step back and see who shined (and who didn’t). Let’s take a look at how regional banks stocks fared in Q2, starting with First Bancorp (NASDAQ:FBNC).
